description: Test suite for PermissionManager functionalities, including permission status checks and ensuring permissions for voice wake, location, and other capabilities.

classes.name: PermissionManagerTests
classes.description: Test suite struct containing permission-related test cases.

methods.name: `voice wake permission helpers match status`
methods.description: Asserts that the generated voice wake permissions match the actual granted permissions.

methods.name: `status can query non interactive caps`
methods.description: Checks that the status query for a list of capabilities returns the correct number of results.

methods.name: `ensure non interactive does not throw`
methods.description: Ensures that requesting permissions non-interactively for a set of capabilities does not throw errors.

methods.name: `location status matches authorization always`
methods.description: Verifies that the permission status for location matches the CLLocationManager's authorization status.

methods.name: `ensure location non interactive matches authorization always`
methods.description: Checks that non-interactive permission request for location matches the current authorization status.
